description: An incident, an adverse event (a theatre one has booking_id) or a near miss was reported: refresh the incident register. Priority critical for a sentinel event (review it at once), high for severe harm or a death.
protocol: WS /ws/v1/events: send {type:'auth', access_token, resume_from, topics}; get_guide('realtime')
rereads_by_id_means: the subscribing screens' reads of one record whose id the payload carries
note: emitted_by_operations: seen in the tests; emitted_in_code: every place that emits it (worker jobs and database triggers included). Treat the payload as a hint and re-read what it names.
